subject: Marketplace onboarding playlist + billing lane for Aurora Bio (GCP private offer)
messages:
From: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@aurorabio.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Mendez <c.mendez@aurorabio.com>, Aurora Bio Procurement <procurement@aurorabio.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Nov 2028 09:13:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Marketplace onboarding playlist + billing lane for Aurora Bio (GCP private offer)

Thanks, Mina. Appreciated the overview in the call — Carlos and I pulled together a quick list of procurement and security questions so we can line up internal stakeholders. Quick summary of asks from procurement/security: 

- Confirm that Redwood will accept a GCP private offer purchase and outline who issues invoices (Aurora wants confirmation whether billing comes via Google marketplace or directly from Redwood).
- We need the SOC 2 summary and retention policy for logs (what's default retention vs. optional retention).
- Are there any data residency controls for our US-East customers (we use us-central1 primarily)?
- Estimated go-live: procurement is pushing for usage in our dev and staging by end of November and production by mid-December.

Could you send a short mutual action plan (MAP) with milestone dates, a checklist the procurement team can sign off on, and the doc for the private offer steps? Attaching our internal procurement template for reference (we'll share PO #s once the private offer is issued).

Thanks — Samantha
Samantha Liu
Head of Platform Engineering | Aurora Bio
Samantha.liu@aurorabio.com
Attachments: Aurora_Procurement_Template.xlsx (referenced)
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@aurorabio.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 07 Nov 2028 12:04:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Marketplace onboarding playlist + billing lane for Aurora Bio (GCP private offer)

Samantha — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Laura (on Marketplace/onboarding) and Aditya (private offers & billing) so we can respond with a concise MAP and the documents you need. Below is a short draft timeline we can use to populate your procurement template. Will attach SOC2 summary and our MAP spreadsheet in the next message.

Draft high-level MAP (proposed)
- Nov 8: Redwood sends MAP + SOC2 summary + draft PO language (you can circulate internally)
- Nov 9–13: Aurora internal security & procurement review (we will be available for 1:1 calls)
- Nov 14: Redwood to issue GCP private offer (requires Aurora billing account ID + billing org contact)
- Nov 15–22: Aurora returns signed PO / marketplace acceptance depending on procurement path
- Nov 27: Staging rollout and acceptance testing begins (2-week eval window)
- Dec 11: Production enablement planned (contingent on PO & security OK)

Key notes: Redwood supports GCP private offers for committed and non-committed purchases. For private offers via GCP Marketplace, billing flows through Google (Aurora is billed by Google) but Redwood will receive the marketplace payout per the private offer terms. If procurement prefers direct invoicing to Aurora (outside marketplace), we can discuss dedicated contract terms — that path will add 2–3 weeks.

Aditya — can you confirm required info for the private offer (billing org ID, contact, any company legal language we need for the GCP private offer)?

Thanks, Mina
Mina Haddad
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
From: aditya_rao@redwood.com <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@aurorabio.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 08 Nov 2028 08:22:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Marketplace onboarding playlist + billing lane for Aurora Bio (GCP private offer)

Thanks for the plan — adding the private-offer checklist and procurement inputs. A few concrete items we need from Aurora to issue the GCP private offer: 

1) GCP Billing Account ID (numeric) and billing contact (name + email)
2) Legal entity full name for contract (exactly as it appears on POs)
3) PO template (if you have mandatory PO fields we should include in the private offer)
4) Any billing exceptions (net terms; Aurora typically asks for Net45, note that marketplace billing via Google follows Google's terms — we can request marketplace invoice fields but payment is to Google)

Private-offer timeline/ops notes:
- We draft the private offer and add agreed SKU/commitment lines. Requires Aurora billing account ID to bind the offer.
- After we publish the private offer, Aurora accepts on the GCP console and Google handles invoicing. Redwood will supply the payout mapping and redemption codes to Google.

Security/Compliance items (attached): SOC2-Summary_Aurora.pdf (summary), Data_Retention_Policy.txt (short), KMS-integration-guide.pdf

I'll also attach a light mutual-action-plan spreadsheet (MAP_Aurora_v0.2.xlsx) with milestone columns and owners. Mina/Laura — please review the milestones I seeded for engineering tasks and the eval window.

- Aditya
Aditya Rao
Commercial Ops, Redwood Inference
From: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@aurorabio.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Cc: Carlos Mendez <c.mendez@aurorabio.com>, procurement@aurorabio.com
Date: Thu, 09 Nov 2028 10:17:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Marketplace onboarding playlist + billing lane for Aurora Bio (GCP private offer)

Thanks Aditya, that's helpful. A couple of clarifications from our side: 

- Aurora prefers Net30; if marketplace forces different cadence we will need to confirm with finance. Please flag if Google will force Net15/Net30.
- Security: SOC2 summary looks good — our security lead wants confirmation of log retention default (you list 30 days) and whether we can set 90 days for audit purposes (we can accept additional fees if needed).
- Timeline: procurement confirmed they can target returning the signed PO by Nov 20 if the private offer is published by Nov 14. That keeps us on your proposed path for Staging on Nov 27.

Can you prepare a DocuSign for the PO acceptance language (we use DocuSign for internal approvals)? If you send the private offer link and a short MAP spreadsheet, procurement will slot the tasks into our tracker and get back with PO #.

Appreciate the speed — Samantha
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>

Samantha — confirming next steps and uploads per your request.

What we've done: 
- Attached: MAP_Aurora_v0.2.xlsx (milestones, owners), SOC2_Summary_Aurora.pdf, Draft_PO_Aurora.docx
- We will request the GCP private offer binding tomorrow once you provide the Billing Account ID and confirmation on Net terms.
- DocuSign: here's the link we'll use for PO acceptance: https://www.docusign.com/CLNK-aurora-po. We seeded the DocuSign with the minimal acceptance clause and PO fields; procurement can edit if needed.

Proposed immediate asks for Aurora (action items): 
1) Share Billing Account ID + billing contact (by EOD Nov 15)
2) Confirm Net terms preference (Net30 or Net45) — if you want Net45 outside marketplace, flag and we will schedule a 15-min procurement sync.
3) Confirm retention requirement (30 vs 90 days) so we can add a line item to the MAP and pricing if necessary.

If those are completed on Nov 15 we will publish the private offer on Nov 16 and circulate the GCP private-offer link. That should keep the Nov 20 PO return date feasible and leave room for the staging window Nov 27.

Let me know if anyone on your side wants a short call tomorrow to walk through the MAP spreadsheet.

Best,
Mina Haddad
